resources.string: No installed plugins. Browse the marketplace or import your own.
Read and interact with webpages in conversation tabs under the current website permissions.
Read PDF and Word documents with page, block and image sources.
Understand chats and draft replies. Reading a phone chat also needs Mobile Use. Does not send automatically.
No additional setup. Select this plugin in a conversation to use it under that conversation’s permissions.
Required guidance accompanies selected plugins. Skill bodies and references load on demand; tool schemas load through discovery. Previewing here does not enable the plugin.
